Sub-Category: Payload Validation (payment_id | amount | reference | description | event_type)
Preconditions: Docker containers running, Database clean, Services healthy
Test Steps:
1. Generate valid payment webhook payload with unique payment ID
2. Sign payload with valid webhook secret
3. Send POST request to /callback/payment endpoint with signature header
4. Wait for webhook storage (2s)
5. Wait for payment processor (5s)
6. Query database for webhook record
7. Query database for payment record
Expected Results: HTTP 200 response received, Webhook stored in payment_webhooks table with status 'received', Payment created in payments table with correct amount, Payment event created in payment_events table
